programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S2 - "Killer Debris from Space"

programmes.t: Rethink S1 - "Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight"
programmes.d: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll take a look at magician’s trade secrets, the contradictions of Zeno’s paradox, and the UV - A Blacklight. We’ll take another look at the levitation illusion, and illusionist David Blaine.

In a world where nothing is what it seems, the lights are off and the spotlight is on the art of shadowgraphy. Next up we’ll explore some card tricks and more optical illusions. Then feature rethinker performer Félicien Treway.

programmes.t: Rethink S1 - "Is moving pictures an illusion?"
programmes.d: In a world where nothing is what it seems, take a look at the shades of colour, explore the Body transfer illusion, Liars paradox and video. Is moving pictures an illusion?

programmes.t: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programmes.d: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

programmes.t: Space Greed S1 - "Asteroid Mining: Is The Next Gold Rush in Space?"
programmes.d: The asteroids flying through our solar system contain tons and tons of precious metals, stones, and more. Are the astronomical profits from mining asteroids all hype?

programmes.t: Space Greed S1 - "Endangered Aliens: Will Humans Trash Space?"
programmes.d: Sci-Fi has always shocked audiences with images of powerful aliens invading and destroying Earth. What if WE are actually the invasive alien species?

programmes.t: Space Greed S1 - "Space Cowboys: Who Will Wrangle Asteroids And Save The Earth?"
programmes.d: The next time another huge space rock jeopardizes Earth, will private space companies and their advanced, expensive, and reusable spacecraft be enough to save the day?
In this episode, we explore all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Preparing for Mars"

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Life Beyond Earth"

Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes… and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. Recent discoveries suggest the number of stars in our galaxy alone may exceed 200 billion.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S2 - "The Dark Side"
programmes.d: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S3 - "Living in Space"
programmes.d: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.
Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

Sending probes throughout the solar system is a mathematician’s dream and an engineer’s nightmare, sling shotting probes around other planets to arrive at their destination, we checkout the latest probes about to slingshot about the solar system.
